source.name: FIA Formula E - Envision Racing team page
source.note: The team raced Season 12 (2025/26) as 'ENVISION RACING' with drivers Eriksson/Buemi (page lists Season 12 standings). The Envision brand is Envision Group's, the team's owner; per the league note the team-title/name placement maps to the schema's front value (leagues/formula-e.json). Paysafe became Title Partner only for the GEN4 era from 2026-27, so it is not on this season's kit.

source.quote: As an official partner of Envision Racing, Teijin provides cutting-edge material technologies
source.note: Club's official partners page (undated). Teijin's partnership dates from 2020 and was renewed for multiple years on 12 July 2022 (envision-racing.com, 'ENVISION RACING ANNOUNCE MULTI-YEAR PARTNERSHIP RENEWAL WITH TEIJIN').

source.name: Envision Racing: Sand Technologies become official partner of Envision Racing

source.note: Multi-year partnership announced 6 November 2024; the same announcement says 'the company will feature on Team collateral from testing'. Still an Official Partner on the club's partners page (fetched 2026-10-03).

source.note: Multi-year alliance announced 27 June 2024; still an Official Partner on the club's partners page (fetched 2026-10-03).

summary: Season 12 (2025/26) Jaguar I-Type 7, raced as Envision Racing: Envision (Envision Group, the team's owner and title brand) on the front; official partners Teijin, Sand Technologies, Southwire, Superdry and Algorand and technical partners OMP and RAW Charging, per the club's partners page as archived on 9 December 2025 and 7 January 2026 (during Season 12) and the club's partnership announcements. The live partners page (fetched 2026-10-04) reflects the 2026/27 season - it lists Paysafe as Title Partner and no longer shows Superdry, Algorand or RAW Charging - so the archived captures are the completeness source for this season. Paysafe became Title Partner only for the GEN4 era (2026-27), announced 14 August 2026, so it is not on this season's kit. Car-livery positions don't map to the schema's placements (league note), so partners are recorded as 'partner'.
